install: set -euo pipefail; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv python install 3.12 && uv venv --python 3.12 --seed --allow-existing .venv-dev && uv pip install --python .venv-dev/bin/python -r requirements-sim.txt -r requirements-test.txt; else python3.12 -m venv .venv-dev && .venv-dev/bin/python -m pip install --no-input -r requirements-sim.txt -r requirements-test.txt; fi && .venv-dev/bin/python -m pip check && ln -sfn .venv-dev .venv-sim && touch "$HOME/.bashrc" && (sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true) && PATH_LINE="export PATH=\"$PWD/.venv-dev/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:\$PATH\"" && (grep -qxF "$PATH_LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || printf '%s\n' "$PATH_LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc") && MUJOCO_LINE='export MUJOCO_GL="${MUJOCO_GL:-egl}"' && (grep -qxF "$MUJOCO_LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || printf '%s\n' "$MUJOCO_LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc")
